name: Inbox
description: What your agents need you to decide, in one place: each question an agent asks is its own item, its options as buttons and the default it takes if you don't answer; the ones it waits on first, with toasts, a badge, the Mac's and the phone's notifications, and the ones where it went with the default already quietly, with Accept all defaults. A coding agent's session that needs you (an approval, an answer to read) is the Agents panel's, or a thread here too with Show agent sessions in Inbox on. Reports are records, listed in the morning brief, not in the inbox; progress shows on the agent's own row. And results to review (research, a clipped page) as files in Inbox/ to settle (into Inbox/.archive/), file away, or snooze till later.
forAgents: A question for the user: `inbox.ask` (options with effects, default, why); something to read later: `inbox.add`.

toasts.label: Toasts
toasts.description: for what needs you (a session asking or answering) and each new result or message; with Open

notifications.label: Mac notifications
notifications.description: while the desktop app is in the background

push.label: Phone notifications
push.description: the iPhone app's, and so the watch's; by default what waits on you, an agent's session that needs you (Approve and Deny for a permission, Reply for its answer) or its report; or every new event. Sent by the machine the session runs on, so a phone several machines know rings once. Needs push set up on this machine (vau docs inbox)

answers.label: Agents' answers
answers.description: a last message with nothing to decide (an answer to your question, a status update); by default it's done quietly, unread on its row in the Agents panel (no badge, toast or notification), or kept in the inbox, told. What asks you something, waits on you or failed always comes

showSessions.label: Show agent sessions in Inbox
showSessions.description: a coding agent's session that needs you (an approval, an answer to read) as a thread here too; off, it's the Agents panel's alone, still with its toasts and notifications, and the Inbox keeps to decisions, results and messages

muted.label: Muted accounts
muted.description: accounts whose sessions never make a thread here; nor a toast or notification: coding agents' accounts, by name or id (a Claude Code account: Work, contact; a claude.ai one, for Claude Code on the web's sessions), still shown in the Agents panel, and a report they write still comes. Muting one settles its threads open now. A thread's menu (Mute the Contact account) and the Agents panel's menu, Notifications, set it too

dispatch.unset: None: only kept in the inbox
dispatch.label: Voice notes go to
dispatch.description: an agent started with each (from the watch, the phone or the app), in a new terminal (claude, codex, claude_personal...); empty: they're only kept in the inbox

voice_audio.label: Keep voice notes' audio
voice_audio.description: as an attachment, above what was said; off, only the words are kept

dispatch_prompt.default:
A voice note from the user, dictated on their watch, phone or computer (names and words may be misheard). It's in the inbox as `{path}`, named after its first words. What they said:

{text}

The user isn't watching. First name the note for what it's about, in a few words: `vau move "{path}" "{folder}/<Title>.md"`. Then work out what it asks for and see it through:
- Something to remember or write down: write it in the vault (vau) and tell the user in one line (vau notify, with --action-open for what to look at).
- A task (code, research, a fix): do it all the way, by the rules of where it's done (a repo's CLAUDE.md); anything outward-facing (messages, posts, purchases) or that can't be undone, don't: ask instead. End it with `vau inbox report` (a one-line TL;DR, each question for the user as a --decision with its options (each saying what it causes), the default you take and a why, the details, screenshots of what changed: vau inbox report --help); the user's answers come back here.

Last, archive the note: `vau inbox settle "{folder}/<Title>.md"` (not by editing its status, which leaves it in the inbox).
dispatch_prompt.label: Voice note prompt
dispatch_prompt.description: what that agent is told; {path} is the note in the inbox, {folder} its folder, {text} what was said

keep_days.label: Days to keep done events
keep_days.description: agents' threads once done; on this machine, under Done on the Inbox page, and what's open stays until it's done

decisions.description: the decisions a file asks, each its question with its options as buttons (the default marked), or its answer: in a decision's own file, itself; in a report, the ones it asked

reply.description: a reply box under an agent's report: what's typed goes back into its session (its terminal, the session resumed while its context is cached, or a new session that reads the report), and its thread is working on it

inbox.description: what needs you: decisions waiting on your answer, agents' sessions that need you, results to review in Inbox/, and messages (what agents work on is the Agents panel's)
inbox.live: agents' events on this machine and the vault's other machines (not in the vault)

events.description: how many of the agents' threads and messages to show in each list, the rest folded into Show N more (0 hides them)

results.description: how many results to review to show (0 hides them)
